articles.title: New Orange-Lipped Monkey Found in Congo!
articles.summary: Scientists found a new monkey in the Congo with bright orange lips and spiky hair. It's only the fifth new African monkey discovered in 75 years. The Likweli lives in small groups and roars loudly.

articles.title: Celine Dion Sings Again After Rare Illness!
articles.summary: Celine Dion returned to the stage in Paris after battling stiff person syndrome, a rare illness that affects her muscles and voice. She cried and told fans, 'I made a promise to come back.'

articles.title: New Family Film 'Jo of Montreal' Brings Hope to West Asia
articles.summary: Director Ameen Nayfeh made a feel-good family film about a 12-year-old boy stranded in a Jordanian village. It's rare for West Asian filmmakers to make movies for kids, and he faced pushback.
